name: Ligitek Electronics Co.,Ltd
summary: Ligitek Electronics Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, processes, and trades in various electronic components in Taiwan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company operates in two segment, First LED Business Unit and Second LED Business Unit. It offers light-emitting-diode (LED) products; flat panel displays; semiconductor-related products; and LED toys, hardware plastic, electronic components, printed circuit boards, thin film switches, flexible printed circuits, diaphragm switches, integrated circuits, electronic watches, computers, computer disks, light-emitting diodes, liquid crystal displays.
